Class GamePayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.GamePayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameServerPayload, ServerPayload, Serializable
public class GamePayload extends Object implements Serializable, GameServerPayload
Represents the complete game state payload broadcasted by the server.

This functions as a full state update containing the current game ID, game status, era index, turn order sequence, active player turn phase, players' status, and the state of the central board.
